title: Three-Year Outcomes of Aflibercept Treatment for Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration: Evidence from a Clinical Setting

groups.agent: aflibercept, fixed dosing in the first year then treat-and-extend
groups.description: Consecutive treatment-naive nAMD eyes; Table 1 columns hold the eyes completing 1, 2 and 3 years of follow-up

exclusions.what: Baseline mean BCVA and mean gain in VA, ETDRS letters, by follow-up year (Table 1, Tab1!R7C2-C5 and R8C3-C5)
exclusions.reason: Not best-corrected acuity (protocol inclusion 1): the Methods state that acuity was measured with the patient's habitual correction where available, supplemented with pinhole correction, and the Discussion states that refracted acuity was not used, although the table row says BCVA.

Complete-case sets (protocol inclusion 5): the caption restricts the columns to patients completing 1, 2 and 3 years of follow-up, and eyes that did not complete the first year were excluded from every analysis, out of a larger treated cohort.

exclusions.what: Proportions of eyes losing or gaining letters or reaching a letter threshold (Tab1!R4-R6)

notes: One further eye was excluded for recurrence of pre-existing intraocular inflammation.
Prior treatment naive; regimen fixed dosing in year 1 then treat-and-extend.
Central subfield macular thickness, fluid status and injection numbers are not extracted.
